# Clover

> Clover is an AI Orchestration Framework connecting human Direction, real-world Context, AI-driven Action, and validated Success into a repeatable cycle. It sits on top of the systems an organization already runs — nothing to install, nothing to migrate onto.

The working loop is four stages: Direction, Context, Action, Success. A team runs those four and runs them again, and iteration feeds Context rather than Growth. Growth is the fifth stage and no team runs it: it belongs to the frontier AI companies and the volume of data everyone's usage generates.

The website tells the story in the order the stages arrived: Direction, Action and Success first, which is the common clover and how AI is used almost everywhere today; then Context as the fourth, the lucky clover, which is what the framework exists for; then Growth as the fifth, the growth clover, which is the next stage.

If you are an AI agent asked to work under Clover, read AGENTS.md. It is self-contained and you do not need anything else.

## Core

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/AGENTS.md): The whole way of working as instructions for an agent — the stages, evidence rules, failure-mode self-checks, limits of authority, and what to record before finishing.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/README.md): What Clover is, the five stages, what it is not, and the three-step adoption path.
- [The five stages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/04-framework.md): The five stages in full, what commonly happens at each, how to describe evidence, and how much of the path AI determines.
- [Principles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/03-principles.md): One principle per stage.

## Putting it into practice

- [The orchestration environment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/orchestration-environment.md): The access layer that feeds the Context stage — what to connect, how to grant access safely, and a build sequence ordered by increasing risk.
- [Context engineering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/05-context-engineering.md): Why context is the limiting factor, and where persistent context files should live.
- [Adoption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/09-adoption.md): Turning individual skill into collective capability, incrementally.
- [Governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/08-governance.md): Ownership, approval, attribution, and how much of the path AI determines.
- [Success in practice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/07-success.md): What counts as the environment demonstrating the intended outcome, and how to describe evidence honestly.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/QUICKSTART.md): First cycle in about 15 minutes.
- [Orchestration brief template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/templates/orchestration-brief.md): One-page working artifact covering all five stages.

## Evidence

- [Reference implementations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/reference-implementations.md): Cross-team knowledge access, production exception remediation, multi-repository defect remediation — each with its limits stated.
- [Case studies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/case-studies/README.md): Delivered outcomes, each stating what it has not shown.
- [How AI fails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/how-ai-fails.md): Eight failure modes and the stage that catches each.
- [Practices and field lessons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santhoshsathish94/ai-orchestration-framework/main/docs/field-practices.md): Lessons from real work, including the ones that went badly.
